meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为应用加上登录认证和权限校验,防止未授权访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发应用并需要实现用户登录和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Add login and permission checks to your app to block unauthorized access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app and need to add user login and permission management

howto.what: Claude 会按 JWT、OAuth2、会话管理与 RBAC 等模式帮你实现或审查登录鉴权代码，并指出密码哈希、令牌过期、限流等常见陷阱。
howto.when: 当你要实现认证系统、保护 REST 或 GraphQL API，或排查鉴权安全问题时，它会介入。

say.text: 帮我用 JWT 给这个 REST API 加登录鉴权
say.note: 会给出令牌签发与校验的实现方案

say.text: 给这套系统加上基于角色的权限控制（RBAC）
say.note: 会说明角色与权限校验的写法

say.text: 帮我检查这段会话管理代码有什么安全问题
say.note: 会列出 Cookie 标志、过期等风险点

howto.what_en: Claude implements or reviews auth code using JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC patterns, and points out pitfalls like plain passwords, tokens without expiry, and missing rate limits.
howto.when_en: Use it when building auth systems, securing REST or GraphQL APIs, or debugging security issues.

say_en.note: Returns token signing and verification steps

Review this session code for security issues
